description: This file defines the Attributes interface and its implementation for handling admission request parameters in the Kubernetes PodSecurity admission controller. It includes data structures, interface methods, and functions to adapt admission requests into a standardized format.

classes.name: Attributes
classes.description: Interface for accessing admission request parameters.

classes.name: AttributesRecord
classes.description: Struct implementing the Attributes interface, representing admission request attributes.

classes.name: attributes
classes.description: Internal struct used to adapt an admission request to the Attributes interface.

methods.name: GetName
methods.description: Returns the name of the object associated with the request.

methods.name: GetNamespace
methods.description: Returns the namespace of the request object.

methods.name: GetKind
methods.description: Returns the kind of the request object.

methods.name: GetObject
methods.description: Returns the typed object from the request.

methods.name: GetOldObject
methods.description: Returns the existing object for update requests.

methods.name: RequestAttributes
methods.description: Function that adapts an admission request to the Attributes interface.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes raw extension data into a runtime.Object.
